cohort.algorithm: exclude historical indices and exact UTF8 clean/donor hashes; deduplicate clean hashes by first official index; proportional largest-remainder exact-template quotas, hash tie breaks; sorted-template seeded permutation5542; final order template/index

evaluation.recorder: read-only metric wrapper captures per-example outputs from unchanged official forwards
evaluation.cache: official graph-independent reference scalars reused across all methods; no activation caching, no mutable patched-activation reuse; frozen completed results may be reused after full identity verification

bootstrap.unit: prompt, shared across all methods/seeds/grid points
bootstrap.stratification: resample within exact official template, fixed observed counts
bootstrap.seed_pooling: equal mean across3 fixed trained seeds for each prompt; never pool3N independent rows or resample seeds
bootstrap.primary_familywise: Bonferroni two endpoints: equal-tail97.5% marginal intervals (quantiles.0125,.9875) give simultaneous>=95%; per-seed intervals control2 endpoints within that seed only
bootstrap.control_familywise: Bonferroni6 pooled control-endpoint contrasts (3controls*2cutoffs); descriptive per-seed contrasts
bootstrap.secondary_auc: paired95% percentile interval, unadjusted and explicitly secondary

criteria.structural: real hierarchy must additionally beat every3 control at both primary endpoints: pooled corrected lower>0 and positive in>=2 seeds each; gamma-zero equivalence prevents residual-penalty attribution
criteria.classification: primary pass=compact-accuracy generalization; primary+allcontrols=structural advantage; positive pooled effects but failed safeguards/uncertainty=mixed/inconclusive; otherwise negative

budget.OOM: stop with message; no silent batch/semantics changes; independent explicit resource amendment needed before rerun

stopping: stop on provenance/cohort/masking/correctness/nonfinite failure or resource cap; no retraining/new methods/further gates/leaderboard
